title: Chest Pass Pound Accuracy
description: Partners practise crisp, two-hand chest passes at a target on the chest, building the accuracy that most other passing drills assume is already there.

content.objective: Deliver a flat, accurate chest pass that arrives at the partner's chest, not their feet or face.
content.setup: Partners stand four metres apart facing each other, one ball per pair.
instructions: Step toward the target and push the ball with both thumbs, snapping the wrists outward.
Aim for the partner's chest on every pass.
Catch with both hands and immediately give a target before returning the pass.
After two minutes, take one step back and repeat at the longer distance.
coachingPoints: Step into every pass — don't pass from a standstill.
Finish with the thumbs pointing down after release.
Call the receiver's name before passing.
commonMistakes: Passing from the waist instead of the chest.
Lobbing the ball instead of a flat, firm pass.
Telegraphing the pass with the eyes before releasing it.
content.safety: Keep pairs spaced well apart so a wild pass doesn't hit a neighbouring group.
